EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN
SELECT p.id, p.title, c.name, SUM(i.quantity * i.price)
FROM products p
JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
  AND p.category IN ('hardware', 'software')
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.price) DESC;
|--SCAN products
|--SEARCH order_items USING INDEX order_items_product_id_idx (product_id=?)
|--SEARCH orders USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
|--SEARCH customers USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
`--USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
